title: Live-cell transcriptomics with engineered virus-like particles
title_zh: 利用工程化病毒样颗粒进行活细胞转录组学
abstract: Transcriptomic profiling is widely applied to characterize cellular gene expression, yet existing approaches lyse cells and preclude direct analysis of transcriptional dynamics in the same sample over time. We addressed this limitation by engineering mammalian cells to "self-report" their transcriptional states via mRNA export in virus-like particles (VLPs). Repeated sampling of culture media from VLP-producing cell populations faithfully captured evolving transcriptional states in complex biological settings, including acute inflammatory stimulation of primary cell spheroids and multi-day differentiation of pluripotent stem cells. We engineered VLP components for multiplexed readouts from distinct cell types in co-culture and for tuning self-reported RNA profiles. Finally, we demonstrated the unique utility of self-reporting for selective longitudinal tracking of endothelial cell dynamics within the enclosed architecture of a microphysiological co-culture system to identify perivascular stroma-dependent temporal gene programs underlying vasculogenesis. Altogether, this work establishes cellular self-reporting as a broadly enabling technology for live-cell transcriptome-wide gene expression profiling.
abstract_zh: 转录组分析广泛用于表征细胞基因表达，但现有方法会裂解细胞，无法在同一样本中随时间直接分析转录动态。我们通过工程化哺乳动物细胞，使其通过病毒样颗粒（VLP）中的mRNA外排“自我报告”转录状态，克服了这一限制。对VLP产生细胞群体培养基的重复采样，能够真实捕捉复杂生物环境中转录状态的演变，包括原代细胞球体的急性炎症刺激和多日多能干细胞的分化。我们为VLP组分设计了多重读取方案，可从共培养的不同细胞类型中分辨并调节自我报告的RNA谱。最后，我们展示了自我报告在微物理共培养系统中对内皮细胞动态进行选择性纵向追踪的独特价值，识别了围血管基质依赖的时间基因程序，揭示了血管生成的机制。总体而言，本研究确立了细胞自我报告作为一种广泛可用的技术，用于活细胞全转录组基因表达分析。
